title: The picture follows the connection, and a viewer can pick a quality
description: Serves PRODUCT.md: "The picture follows the connection ... A viewer can override it at any time: pick a quality and it stays until they choose automatic again. The versions are the original, always the best, and a few lighter steps below it. 720p is the usual floor; 480p is offered only for a film whose own picture is SD, or when nothing higher keeps it playing. No step is larger than the film itself." The engine makes one quality today.
acceptanceCriteria: On a weak or crowded connection the picture steps down to a lighter version and back up when it can, while the film keeps playing, with no setting to find first.
The versions offered are the original and a few lighter steps, 720p the usual floor, 480p only for an SD film or when nothing higher keeps it playing, none larger than the film.
A viewer picks a quality and it stays until they choose automatic again; they can see which quality they are watching.
The design states the storage and CPU the steps cost.
notes: Coarse: sharpened when stage 3 is planned in detail.
